systemTitle: UDO Medical OS v1.1 - The Future Clinic Upgrade
summary: Unified Medical OS integrating CGM ALBIS KTX Kassenarzt-scaffold, S2k AI-Gutachten Engine, Telematikinfrastruktur 2.0, Real-time Predictive Practice Analytics, and Proactive DSGVO Guardian.

phases.name: Data Unification & ALBIS KTX Live Bridge
phases.description: Bi-directional ALBIS KTX API data bridge simulating patient master records, ICD-10 diagnoses, and OCR lab values across 10 synthetic patient files.

phases.name: Unified Workspace ('The One Window')
phases.description: Drag-and-drop waiting room check-in queue integrated with appointment calendar, side-by-side Gutachten canvas, and global instant search.

phases.name: AI-Assisted Gutachten & Instant GOÄ Coding
phases.description: AI-driven draft report synthesis with watermarking and instant regex mapping to GOÄ, EBM, and JVEG fee catalogs with 1-click billing acceptance.

phases.name: Predictive Practice Cockpit (Analytics 2.0)
phases.description: Recharts revenue breakdown by service and LANR physician, 30-day linear regression predictive AI revenue forecasts, and anomaly drop alerts.

phases.name: Autonomous Telematics Engine (TI 2.0)
phases.description: Automated batch generator for eRezept, eAU, eArztbrief, and ePA with animated secure gateway simulation, retry queue, and audit tracking.

phases.name: Voice-Driven Mobile Scribe
phases.description: Web Speech API voice transcription with LLM medical term cleanup and real-time cross-device sync to desktop report editor.

phases.name: Intelligent Patient Triage & Prior Auth Engine
phases.description: NLP referral letter scanner identifying acute DGUV/emergency cases, priority badge queue, and automated Kostenübernahme PDF generator.

phases.name: MVZ & Multi-Practice Ecosystem
phases.description: 5-location practice switcher (Berlin, Munich, Hamburg, Cologne, Frankfurt) with aggregated MVZ master revenue charts and masked cross-location patient lookup.

phases.name: Proactive GDPR 'Guardian' & Compliance System
phases.description: Proximity auto-lock simulation, unauthorized file access detection, Data Subject Rights JSON exporter, and downloadable DSGVO audit report PDF.

phases.name: Future Clinic Concierge AI Assistant
phases.description: Floating FAB assistant chatbot with calendar SMS reminder automation, prescription inventory alerts, and automated workflow dispatching.

phases.name: Global Whitepaper & Investor Presentation Generator
phases.description: Dynamic investor-ready presentation matrix, full-screen interactive slideshow mode, and automatic PDF whitepaper export.
